about: A signature algorithm, defined by this blob and named on the wire only by its digest.

Ed25519 as RFC 8032 defines it (PureEdDSA over edwards25519). The message is the UTF-8 bytes of the claim's canonical line without its sig field, with its signer named; the public key is the 32-byte key wrapped as SubjectPublicKeyInfo DER, in base64; the signature is the 64 raw bytes, in base64.
A later epoch admits another definition by its digest; a line signed under this one stays readable for as long as this blob is kept.
